name: Sleevy
description: A native-first read-later service. Save any URL to a personal reading queue and manage the saved items and folders in it, from an agent, a script, or any of the Sleevy clients.

skills.name: save_link
skills.description: Save an HTTP or HTTPS link to the person's Sleevy read-later queue. Returns the Saved Item, which is created if the URL is new and updated if it was already saved.

skills.name: save_links_batch
skills.description: Save up to 50 links in one request. Each entry reports its own outcome, so one bad URL does not stop the rest from being saved.

skills.name: list_saved_items
skills.description: List the person's Saved Items, newest first, filtered by folder and paged with an opaque cursor.

skills.name: set_saved_item_read_state
skills.description: Mark a Saved Item read or unread, or record that the person opened it.

skills.name: set_saved_item_folder
skills.description: Move a Saved Item into a Folder, or take it out of the one it is in.

skills.name: delete_saved_item
skills.description: Permanently delete a Saved Item. Cannot be undone, so an agent should confirm with the person first.

skills.name: manage_folders
skills.description: List, create, rename, recolour, publish, and delete the person's Folders. Deleting a Folder keeps the Saved Items inside it.
